name: Furniture and Decor
description: Three groups of mods cover non-Create building.

pages.title: Furniture and Decor
pages.text: Three groups of mods cover non-Create building. **Handcrafted** adds furniture. The **Macaw's** mods add doors, roofs and windows. **Supplementaries** adds many small useful blocks. Create-flavoured decor is in [#](2E5AAC)[Create Decor](entry://home/create_decor)[#]().

pages.title: Handcrafted
pages.text: Tables, benches, couches, desks, drawers, shelves, counters, beds, sheets and cushions in many wood types. Plus trophies and pillar trims for the walls.

pages.title: Macaw's Roofs
pages.text: Many roof shapes: attic, top and lower base roofs per wood and material. A Roofing Hammer helps. Macaw's Doors and Windows follow the same pattern.

pages.title: Macaw's Windows
pages.text: Resizeable windows, plus a Window Hammer and Window Key. Macaw's Doors adds many door styles and a Garage Remote.

pages.title: Supplementaries
pages.text: Jars hold small things. Also flags, awnings, bunting, candle holders, goblets, book piles, soap and a Wrench. Browse the item list in JEI.

Furniture here is mostly decor. For seats on moving contraptions, Create's own Seat works, and [#](2E5AAC)[Coasters](entry://transport/coasters)[#]() add coaster seats.

Cafe-style decor ties into [#](2E5AAC)[Cozy Cafe](entry://food/cozy_cafe)[#]().
